You can measure your ring size at home `using a thin strip of paper or a piece of string and a ruler`.[[1]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/how-to-measure-ring-size-at-home/)

### Measuring with Paper or String

1. Cut a thin strip of paper or take a piece of string (about 6 inches long).
2. Wrap it snugly around the base of the finger where the ring will sit. Make sure it is comfortable and not too tight.
3. Check that it can also slide over your knuckle.
4. Mark the spot where the paper or string overlaps with a pen.
5. Lay the strip or string flat next to a ruler.
6. Measure the length in millimeters.
7. Compare your millimeter measurement to a standard ring size chart (like the one on [Tiffany](https://www.tiffany.com/client-services/size-guide.html) or [Gabriel & Co.](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/how-to-measure-ring-size/)).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3OWMx1goHE4)[[2]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/how-to-measure-ring-size-at-home/)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/Gemsny/videos/how-to-check-your-ring-size-cut-a-thin-strip-of-paper-wrap-the-paper-around-the-/520821974286099/)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/TenenbaumsJewelry/videos/heres-how-to-find-your-ring-size-at-home-lifehack-jewelryhack/1995435397774595/)[[5]](https://us.danielwellington.com/blogs/user-guides/how-to-measure-your-ring-size)[[6]](https://www.tiffany.com/client-services/size-guide.html)

### Measuring an Existing Ring

1. Pick a ring that already fits the target finger well.
2. Place it on a flat surface and use a ruler to measure the **inside diameter** straight across the center in millimeters.
3. Match that diameter number to a ring size conversion chart.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YgykMksGMlc&t=50)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/wkCymEYLTVw)

### Tips for Accuracy

- **Measure later in the day:** Fingers swell slightly in the evening or when warm.
- **Avoid the cold:** Cold temperatures make your fingers shrink.
- **Consider band width:** Thick bands feel tighter, so you may need to go up half a size.[[1]](https://www.fredmeyerjewelers.com/Assets/Pdfs/ring-size-finder.pdf)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/TenenbaumsJewelry/videos/heres-how-to-find-your-ring-size-at-home-lifehack-jewelryhack/1995435397774595/)[[3]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/how-to-measure-ring-size-at-home/)

If you'd like, tell me:

- Your **millimeter measurement** or current ring diameter
- Whether you are shopping for a **thin or wide band** 

I can help you find your exact size estimate.
